Long Description

Oracle ARCS Lead

Location: Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad
Experience: 8–12 Years

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading organizations transform and automate their Account Reconciliation processes through Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) and drive operational excellence across finance functions.

Your Role

As an Oracle ARCS Lead, you will be responsible for leading the implementation of Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) solutions. You will work closely with finance stakeholders, business users, and technical teams to deliver scalable account reconciliation solutions while driving project success from requirements gathering through deployment and post-production support.

In this role, you will:

Lead requirements gathering and discovery workshops with business stakeholders. Analyze requirements related to account reconciliation processes and controls. Design detailed components of Oracle ARCS solutions based on business requirements. Provide technical leadership and mentor development teams in resolving complex implementation challenges. Drive client discussions, conduct solution reviews, and obtain design sign-offs. Collaborate with stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle to ensure successful delivery. Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and issue resolution activities. Lead production deployment activities and provide post-production support. Ensure adherence to Oracle ARCS implementation best practices and governance standards.

Your Profile

8–12 years of experience in Oracle EPM solutions with at least 2 end-to-end Oracle ARCS implementations. Proven experience in designing and implementing Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) solutions. Strong understanding of account reconciliation processes, financial controls, and month-end close activities. Knowledge of Oracle ARCS architecture, configuration, and design principles. Experience leading client workshops, requirement discussions, solution design sessions, and implementation activities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to mentor project teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with strong stakeholder management capabilities. Good documentation and solution design experience. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Primary Skills-Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS), Account Reconciliation Process, Transaction Matching, Reconciliation Compliance, Oracle EPM Cloud, Solution Design, Requirements Analysis, UAT Support, Production Deployment. Secondary Skills - Hyperion Account Reconciliation Manager (ARM), Financial Controls, Month-End Close Process, Oracle EPM Architecture, Stakeholder Management, Technical Documentation, Team Mentoring, Financial Reporting.

About Us

At Capgemini, we are a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations accelerate their dual transformation to address the evolving needs of customers and citizens. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths in strategy, design, engineering, and technology to help clients innovate and grow.

Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

    • Business Roles

    • RBAC Design
    • User Administration
    • Access Governance

  • SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG).
  • SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS).

  • SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Security.
  • SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, EAM, BRM).

Your Role

  • Configure and support SAP Treasury, Cash Management, BCM, EBS, and Banking solutions in SAP environments.
  • Manage Bank Master Data, House Banks, Bank Accounts, Payment Processes, and Banking Interfaces. 
  • Implement and enhance EBS, Lockbox, EDI/IDOC, APP, and PMW solutions to streamline payment and reconciliation processes. 
  • Configure Treasury processes including cash positioning, cash forecasting, liquidity management, and risk management. 
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, provide solutions, conduct testing, and support end-to-end implementations.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of experience as an SAP Treasury & Cash Management / FSCM Functional Consultant with expertise in banking, payments, cash management, and treasury processes.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Bank Master Data, House Bank & Bank Account Management, EBS, Lockbox, EDI/IDOC, and BCM configurations.
  • Expertise in Automatic Payment Program (APP), Payment Medium Workbench (PMW), Payment Requests, and Approval Workflows.
  • Experienced in In-House Cash, Payment on Behalf Of (POBO), Cash Pooling, Intercompany Netting, and Cash Flow Forecasting.
  • Good knowledge of SAP Treasury & Risk Management, including Transaction Management, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Hedge Management, and Cash Management.
